text.p: - Albania is on the verge of a civil war.
- Kuban, crop-rich region in the south of Russia, headed by a newly-elected communist governor is seeking wide independence from Moscow.
- Russia opens new space launching pad Svobodny in the Far East.
- Train ticket prices rose 10 percent from March 1.
- Both Russian commercial banks and the U.S. government refuse to claim ownership of the mysterious $10 million cash aid package to Russia, part of which was stolen from a London airport.
- The eastern region of Irkutsk wants to keep its federal tax payments to itself.
- Turkey is doing its best to keep Russian small importers coming.
- Political parties of different shapes and sizes are launching fierce attacks on the government.
- Only one in five men of military service age goes to serve in the army.
- Russia may have to start building special prisons for HIV-infected convicts to avoid a looming AIDS epidemic among those living in promiscuity behind bars.
